```{r}
#| label: setup-03
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(car)
library(gt)
```

```{r}
#| label: level-3-reading
#| include: false

screened_data <- read_csv2(
  "../../Data/IntermediateData/whoqol_screened.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

items <- screened_data |>
  select(Q1:Q26) |>
  mutate(across(everything(), as.numeric))
```

## VIF calculation per item

The VIF (Variance Inflation Factor) diagnoses multicollinearity among items.
Values above 5 indicate problematic multicollinearity, anticipating
convergence and interpretation issues in CFA.

```{r}
#| label: vif-calculation

response <- seq_len(nrow(items))
model <- lm(response ~ ., data = items)
vif_values <- car::vif(model)
```

### VIF Table

```{r}
#| label: vif-table

vif_df <- tibble(
  Item = names(vif_values),
  VIF  = round(as.numeric(vif_values), 3),
  Problematic = if_else(VIF > 5, "Yes", "No")
)

vif_df |>
  knitr::kable(
    caption = "Variance Inflation Factor (VIF) per item — VIF > 5 indicates problematic multicollinearity",
    digits  = 3
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: base-export
#| include: false

# Export VIF table
write_csv2(vif_df, "../../Output/DataAppendixOutput/vif_table.csv")

final_analysis_data <- screened_data |>
  select(ID, Q1:Q26)

write_csv2(final_analysis_data, "../../Data/AnalysisData/whoqol_analysis.csv")
```
